pricing_text: Billing is calculated per second of video generated: **$0.09 at 720p**, **$0.13 at 1080p**, **$0.19 at 1440p**, and **$0.30 at 4K**. Native audio is included at every resolution. For example, a **10-second video at 1080p costs $1.30**.
notes: usd للأرخص (720p)؛ الافتراضي في المخطط 1080p = $0.13/ث. مفاتيح by_resolution تطابق enum المخطط (2160p = 4K). الصوت مضمّن. المدد 6–20 ث أو auto.
